newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope suffering from flu, ordered to rest.
newsitem.headline: Pope suffering from flu, ordered to rest.

text.p: Pope John Paul is suffering from influenza and has been told to rest in bed for a few days, the Vatican said on Wednesday.

The Vatican issued a statement on the health of the 76-year-old Pope shortly after an announcer told pilgrims gathered in St Peter's Square that the Roman Catholic leader would not appear for his weekly general audience.
"The Pope is suffering from a sore throat that began last night and stems from influenza. He has been told to rest in bed for a few days," Chief Vatican spokesman Joaquin Navarro-Valls said.
The Pope would make a brief address from the window of his apartment overlooking St Peter's Square later on Wednesday morning, the spokesman said.
Private audiences that had been scheduled for Thursday with Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar and Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer have also been postponed, Navarro-Valls said.

The Polish Pontiff has suffered a string of health problems in recent years, including surgery to remove a colon tumour in 1992, a hip replacement operation in 1994 and an operation last October to remove his appendix.
